working_definition: Olfactory projection neuron type vPN (Xie et al. 2021) at 0 h or 24 h APF.
searches_performed: immature antennal lobe projection neuron vPN

best_match.fbbt_term: pupal antennal lobe projection neuron vPN
best_match.fbbt_definition: Transcriptional clusters corresponding to this cell type were identified in single-cell RNA-seq data from pupal stages (Li et al., 2017; Xie et al., 2021). vPN clusters were identified at 24h APF by the expression of known vPN markers (Li et al., 2017; Xie et al., 2021). It is not known whether these cells are larval-born neurons (immature at pupal stages) or embryonic-born neurons (remodelling at pupal stages). Antennal lobe projection neuron of the pupa that will become an adult antennal lobe projection neuron vPN (Xie et al., 2021).

justification: Ventral PNs (vPNs), not resolved to a type. Up to the pupal stage the immature or pupal term is used (curator); FBbt #2220, release 2026-11-02. Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: vPN 110, APL 4. kn+ PNs (knot analysis, no lineage column): the paper states they "include six types of adPNs and two vPNs" (Figure 2), i.e. D, DM6, VA1v, VM2, VM7, VM5v (adPN) and the two vPNs.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053703 pupal antennal lobe projection neuron vPN (exact match).
